title: Kernel-Based Learning of Analytic Operators and Parametric PDEs
abstract: arXiv:2611.09612v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study kernel-based learning of analytic operators from finite samples, with a focus on how the regularity of the target should determine the choice of the kernel. We establish embeddings of analytic operators into vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces and derive finite-sample, high-probability guarantees that quantify the uncertainty due to random sampling: in the noiseless setting, suitable analytic kernels yield rates exponential in a fractional power of the sample size, while Sobolev-type kernels yield polynomial rates. We apply the theory to the solution operator of a parametric elliptic PDE, where the training data are themselves finite-element approximations, and obtain bounds that separate the sampling and discretization contributions to the error and prescribe how the mesh size should be coupled to the sample size. The results are illustrated numerically.

translated_title: 基于核方法的分析算子与参数化偏微分方程学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究基于核方法从有限样本中学习解析算子的问题，重点关注目标的正则性应如何决定核的选择。我们建立了解析算子到向量值再生核希尔伯特空间的嵌入，并推导了有限样本、高概率意义下的理论保证，以量化随机采样带来的不确定性：在无噪声情形下，合适的解析核可获得样本数量分数次幂的指数级收敛速率，而Sobolev型核只能获得多项式级速率。我们将该理论应用于参数化椭圆偏微分方程的解算子，其中训练数据本身是有限元近似，并得到了能够分离采样误差与离散化误差贡献的界，同时规定了网格尺寸应如何与样本数量相耦合。研究结果通过数值实验加以验证。
tldr: 该论文建立了基于核方法从有限样本学习解析算子的理论，证明合适的解析核可实现指数级收敛速率，并将其应用于参数化椭圆偏微分方程的解算子学习，给出了分离采样误差与有限元离散化误差的误差界及网格-样本耦合准则。
